title: Legendary Weapons V3
description: Legendary Weapons adds powerful mythical artifacts that unleash magic teleportation chaos and explosive abilities turning battles into legendary encounters
body:
🌟 Legendary Weapons: Power Beyond Mortals 🌟

Step into a world where ordinary steel is not enough.
Legendary Weapons introduces mythical artifacts forged by the gods themselves — weapons that bend reality, summon chaos, and shatter the limits of combat.

⚔️ Wield the Midas Gauntlet – turn weakened foes into pure gold, consume ingots for godlike buffs, and watch enemies tremble before your golden touch.
💥 Unleash Firework Fury – ignite the battlefield as mobs are strapped to rockets, soaring skyward in explosive chaos.
🌌 Master the Blade of Shadows – strike enemies and vanish in a blink, teleporting across the battlefield while delivering deadly magical blows.
🎇 Harness Christmas Spirit – ride enchanted fireworks through the skies, defying gravity as you blaze across the horizon.

Every weapon tells a story.
Every strike reshapes the world.
Do you have what it takes to master their power — or will the power master you?

# Current Swords: 
# 

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Thunder Blade
Forged in the heart of a storm, this blade crackles with divine lightning. Each strike summons bolts of thunder upon your enemies. On right-click, unleash a godly smite that strikes every entity within a 64-block radius. Attack Damage: 14, Durability: 5000, Cooldown: 250 ticks.

Whirlwind Blade
Born from the breath of tempests, this blade carries the power of the endless skies. On hit, it releases a mighty gust of wind that hurls enemies backward, even Iron Golems and Wardens. On right-click, it summons a raging vortex around you, dealing 7 attack damage and scattering foes randomly. Attack Damage: 14, Durability: 5000, Cooldown: 175 ticks.

Explosion Blade
A weapon born from chaos and fire, the Explosion Blade turns every strike into a gamble. On hit, there is a 1 in 5 chance to trigger a massive explosion around you. Attack Damage: 14, Durability: 5000.

Infinity Blade
The weapon beyond gods — fragile yet unbreakable, carrying limitless power. Base Attack Damage: 3, Durability: 10000000, Deals infinite damage.

Christmas Spirit
A festive relic of chaos and cheer. On attack, enemies are sent flying as enchanted fireworks latch onto them. On right-click, summon a storm of fireworks lifting every entity within a 64-block radius. Attack Damage: 14, Durability: 5000, Cooldown: 600 ticks.

Icespike Blade
Forged from eternal frost, the Icespike Blade chills the air with every strike. On attack, it inflicts slowness and mining fatigue, while summoning ice blocks to trap enemies. Attack Damage: 14, Durability: 5000.

Halloween Spirit Blade
A cursed weapon born from shadows and fear. Struck enemies are marked for death, drawing nearby mobs while wither and darkness sap their strength. The wielder gains health on each hit. On right-click, summon three witches to aid you if a target is marked. Attack Damage: 14, Durability: 5000.

Midas Gauntlet
The golden relic of kings and tyrants. Enemies below 25% health are transformed into gold ingots. Consuming ingots from your offhand grants Strength III, Speed III, and Regeneration III for one minute. Attack Damage: 14, Durability: 5000, Cooldown: 2000 ticks. A hidden twist awaits those daring enough to use it in battle.

Soul Slasher
A blade that pierces not just flesh but the very essence of its victims. Each hit steals life from enemies while teleporting the wielder 2–3 blocks away in a devastating teleporting slash. Attack Damage: 14, Durability: 5000.


</details>
